name: Cyclamates
aliases: E952, cyclamates, cyclamic acid, sodium cyclamate, calcium cyclamate, ciclamato, ácido ciclámico
what_is: An intense synthetic sweetener approximately 30 to 40 times sweeter than sucrose.
why_botia: It is an artificial sweetener characteristic of ultra-processed food formulations.
can_1: Detect E952 or its salts on scanned ingredient lists.
can_2: Map the product as containing artificial sweeteners under the NOVA system.
cannot_1: Measure the exact concentration of cyclamate in the final product.
cannot_2: Determine if chemical impurities exceed safe purity thresholds.
